verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own background automations: plain-English signals and alert rules that run continuously in real time, triage fires automatically, and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email or webhook. Learned fixes also ship in shadow mode and graduate to full traffic without manual intervention. These automations are limited to monitoring and agent improvement, not general-purpose automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose or user-defined automation workflows, scheduled/recurring job configuration, documentation of setup and limits for autonomous runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Bento trains a signal on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your entire history
Bento groups fires into incidents and judges each one real or benign
Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
